```yaml
name: Integration Nightly

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # nightly at 02:00 UTC

jobs:
  generate-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Generate matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          npx ts-node matrix-generator.ts > matrix.json
          echo "matrix=$(cat matrix.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  integration:
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run integration test
        run: npx ts-node run-single.ts "${{ matrix.config }}"
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: integration-logs-${{ matrix.config }}
          path: logs/${{ matrix.config }}.log

  community:
    needs: integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run community tests
        run: npx ts-node community-runner.ts
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Upload community logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: community-logs
          path: community-logs/*.log

  summary:
    needs: [integration, community]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Generate summary
        run: |
          echo "Integration Nightly Summary" > summary.txt
          echo "" >> summary.txt
          echo "Integration Tests:" >> summary.txt
          echo "Result: ${{ needs.integration.result }}" >> summary.txt
          echo "" >> summary.txt
          echo "Community Tests:" >> summary.txt
          echo "Result: ${{ needs.community.result }}" >> summary.txt
      - name: Upload summary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: integration-summary
          path: summary.txt
```
